$comment: The chart's own surface only. The common library's schema is NOT applied at the root: its `ingress` is a map of Ingress objects while ours is {scope, host}, so the two contradict each other. The library's surface is reachable through `raw:`, which is $ref'd to it below - which is also the point: an app reaches the library deliberately, not by accident.

owner.description: Owning team. Fans out to Kubernetes labels, Datadog tags, the ApplicationSet label and CODEOWNERS, so review routing and escalation routing cannot drift apart.
owner.$comment: Owning team slug. INCOMPLETE - seeded from the `team:` labels in owner/argocd and the teams named in this rollout. Must be filled from the OwnerTeam catalog (31 slugs) before v0.1.0 is tagged; a checked-in list keeps the render path free of live catalog calls, at the cost of needing a deliberate PR to add a team.

archetype.description: Which resources render. Add an archetype when it changes *which* resources render; add a value when it changes *how many*.
archetype.$comment: temporal-worker, cron and stateful are deferred. owner-keycloak's StatefulSet shape is not covered by v0.1.0 at all.

serviceName.description: Datadog / UST service name. Defaults to the release name.

role.description: Access-role suffix. Fans out to the ServiceAccount name, both assume-role ARNs and the database login.

port.description: Container port for the HTTP archetype.

livenessPath.description: A SHALLOW endpoint that does not check dependencies. Null falls back to a TCP check on `port`. Pointing liveness at a dependency-checking endpoint turns an upstream outage into a fleet-wide restart loop.

startupBudgetSeconds.description: Divided by the 5s startup period to get failureThreshold.

tlsCompanion.description: Render ONLY the cert-manager Certificate, into the ingress-gateway namespace. Set by the tls-<cluster> variant overlay.

cluster.description: Key into cluster.databases. An unknown key fails the render - a cluster the catalog does not know about gets a catalog entry, not a host override.

name.description: Replication-group name. Not derivable from the release name, so it stays explicit.

endpoint.description: Escape hatch for an off-pattern endpoint (a shared cluster, or a `replica.` reader). Wins over the composed host.

client.description: Register the Temporal client on the API container.

services.description: In-cluster services, keyed into cluster.services. Each yields a <NAME>_URL env var and an egress rule.

domain.description: Keyed into cluster.opensearch.domains. The VPC endpoint carries a random suffix, so it cannot be derived.

workers.description: A map of N workers, each with independent resources and autoscaling.

env.description: App-team-owned. Keys the chart derives are rejected at render time; see templates/_validate.tpl.

secretKeys.description: Key NAMES only. Values live in Secrets Manager and never appear in git.

raw.description: Tier 4. Direct passthrough to the common library, merged last. Identity fields are rejected at render time. CONVENTION: every raw block carries a comment saying why it is here.

cluster.description: Platform-owned cluster facts, from argocd/defaults/<cluster>.yaml. Loaded as the first valueFile so an endpoint change reaches every consumer at once instead of needing a fleet-wide targetRevision bump.
